fov.name: AVP optimized trade-off
fov.note: Optimized trade-off: the author's fit of 2026-11-20 (1.4 line test, GeekVR light seal, each edge and corner line brought back until just visible). The games are told 0.92 / 0.58 / 0.90 / 0.77 (outer / inner / upper / lower tangents, the larger of the two eyes per edge): narrower than AVP optimized quality and taller than AVP optimized performance, 2.50 tangent units of area against 2.22 and 3.39. Its mask (four corner lines per eye) hides about 35 % of the left eye's picture and 40 % of the right's; it is stored with the profile and not yet sent to games. One wearer's fit: if an edge shows black, calibrate your own (the line test starts on this profile). A field of view only; the stream settings come from the headset profile.
